public_rationale: Marcus said AI is real, pointing to everyday tools like speech recognition, navigation, search and recommendations. In October 2024 Google said all seven of its products with more than 2 billion monthly users, including Google Maps, use its Gemini AI models. It also said AI Overviews in Search would reach more than a billion users a month. A late-2022 Pew survey, cited as context, found 27% of Americans said they interact with AI at least several times a day. Together these show AI was in real, mass everyday use when he wrote.
limitations: His own daily use cannot be checked.
The 2024 evidence centers on one company's products.

our_interpretation: Read as: AI systems are in real, widespread everyday use in products such as search, navigation, speech recognition and recommendations.
His own personal daily use cannot be checked and is not scored.
He named no period. I use calendar 2024 up to the post date, the latest period evidence before the post could report on.
criteria.support_condition: Primary sources from 2024 show AI built into widely used consumer products such as web search and maps.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence shows that the named everyday products did not use AI, or that AI had no real deployed uses.
